mentions.name: Ongoing Things
mentions.description: This app lets people document and privately share life updates with close people. Each topic (like raising a child, a trip, or a project) gets its own private space, called an Ongoing Thing, where updates stay organized. Subscribers get email notifications for new posts; there is no feed, no comments, and no ads. A Partner Things feature allows multiple people (like two parents) to post to the same Ongoing Thing.
mentions.problem: Posting personal updates in group chats was scattered, repetitive, and easy to miss.
mentions.audience: close people such as family and friends
mentions.source_excerpt: Still building https://ongoingthings.com - a way to document and privately share life updates with close people.
